description: Agent-first CLI for audio/video transcription via Whisper, published as @crafter/trx
rules: Install as @crafter/trx, not trx: `bunx @crafter/trx` or `npm install -g @crafter/trx`
The trx binary is a Bun script; Bun must be installed even when using npm/npx
Run `trx init` once before transcribing; it installs whisper-cli/yt-dlp/ffmpeg and downloads the model
Output is JSON automatically when piped; use `--fields text` to keep agent context small
